title: Landing hero headline: Black Ops One font with filled orange “FREE”

requirements.summary: Update the landing page hero headline to use the “Black Ops One” font and render “FREE” as filled primary orange text (no outline/transparent fill).
acceptanceCriteria: On route "/", the hero headline “RIDE FREE. RIDE FAR.” is rendered using the Black Ops One font.
The “FREE” word is clearly filled with the orange primary color (not transparent fill), while the rest of the headline styling remains readable and consistent with the current hero layout.
No other user-facing text is changed as part of this update.

file_operations.description: Update the hero <h1> typography to use the existing Tailwind font token that maps to “Black Ops One” (e.g., switch from font-display to font-heading), and adjust the “FREE.” span to use the primary theme color as a normal filled text color (keep text-primary, remove the transparent fill/outline-only styling such as WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent' and any stroke styling). Ensure only the hero headline styling changes and no other visible copy is modified.
